## sakt-p02

source_text: [and]-etal lakṣaṇam uddiṣṭam utthāpanam ataḥ param prabuddhāṃ cintayecchaktiṃ daṇḍavat parameśvarīm utthāpanaṃ samākhyātaṃ bodhanaṃ paratastathā kaṇṭhasthamacyutaṃ sākṣādrudraṃ tālutale sthitam bodhayitvā vrajed āśu padaṃ cānāśritaṃ śivam svābhāvikaṃ dalaṃ dīptaṃ dravaṃ sthiranabhopamam bindunādaṃ tathā proktaṃ cakradvādaśakaṃ kila viśramet sā mahādevī cakraviśrāma uttamaḥ śiraśca bhramate tasya dṛṣṭisaṃkrāntilakṣaṇam ghūrṇate hṛdayaṃ cāsya samyagvidyāprabhāvataḥ

## sakt-p03
